result: I implemented `Number.prototype.toLocaleString` to call `this_number_value` and return the decimal `Number::toString` result, since the engine has no locale data. `cargo clippy` is clean and all 8 tests under `built-ins/Number/prototype/toLocaleString/` pass. All 8 already passed before my change, so there are no new passes, which is why attempts 486 and 488 were rejected for that.
